header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH,
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
Mr. Kanji Mal Meghwar advocate for the petitioner.
XEN Jamrao Awais Ahmed Mirza is present.
Mr. Sintosh Kumar J. Kalal advocate files Vakalatnama on behalf of
body: the respondent No.4, taken on record. This petition has been filed seeking directions to the respondents to supply water to the petitioner as per scheduled share list.

The XEN, Jamrao is present and undertakes that water will be provided to the petitioner as per share list in accordance with law. In view of such situation, the petition is disposed of with directions to the respondents to provide water to the petitioner for irrigating his land in accordance with law. The petition stands disposed of in the above terms.
